results.title: Delete a model with limitations and assumptions attached
results.evidence: the GOES disposition on `model_limitation` and `model_assumption` cannot fire through the delete route. Both rows carry a NOT NULL `model_version_id` ({'model_limitation': False, 'model_assumption': False}), so neither can exist without a version — and `model_version` blocks a deletion unconditionally, so a model that has either is always refused: 'still_referenced', {"error":"still_referenced","d
